title: Mizzen URL lock
description: Every URL a record page has published. mizzen build --update-urls writes it; every build checks against it.

collections.description: Record ids by collection name, then by record id.

url.description: The record page's current URL, including base.

previous.description: Earlier URLs, oldest first; each redirects to url.

removed.description: The record is no longer in its collection; the id and URL are kept so a new record cannot take them.
